We would like you to draw three idol units of original characters.

Unit theme: dolls, idols, machines

First (center): Inochi
Black, long hair to waist level, bangs are thin, just over the eyes, slicked back to the left side, with a princess cut.
Eyes: Vivid red, pinched, large, with long eyelashes.
Costume: Gothic Lolita, black and red, Western doll image.
Personality: Bright, loves cute things, smiles a lot, best friends with Mariya

Second: Mariya
Hair: White, bob cut just below the shoulders, see-through bangs to just below the eyebrows, hair on the sides of the bangs not hanging over the ears
Eyes: Sky-blue, slanted, with long lower lashes.
She has a mole on the right side of her mouth.
Costume: A white and light blue version of Inochi's costume, with the image of an angel (I want to incorporate wings somewhere).
Personality: Calm and natural, objective to everyone, good friend of Inochi and Inochi

Third: Omoi
Hair: Gray, up to the chest area, inwardly curled in layers, M-shaped bangs, crossed in the middle, layered cut around the face.
Eyes: Saturated purple with glazed eyes and long lower lashes.
Costume: A gray and purple version of Inochi's costume, with an androgynous image.
Personality: A little twisted and quiet, she has a distorted desire for her best friend, like faith.

I love Meisuke-sama's sense of style, so I would like to leave the costume design, colors, composition, etc. to her.
I apologize for the length of this essay.
If it is possible, I would appreciate it very much.

Hello! I really like your SD character art. I'd like to request one of my character, Nep.
He is a wolf boy with a flirty personality. I would like him to be smiling and have a confident pose.
Please include a version with a transparent background. Thank you.

It is nice to meet you!
I love your illustrations and would love to have you as my illustrator.

I would like to have a one-picture illustration and a two-headed miniature character!

One-picture
I would like you to draw a figure lying down as shown in the sample. I want to make it a Cheki-style image, so please draw it in 3:4 size.
I like the hands that Mr. Niai draws, so I would be happy if you could draw her lying down with her cheekbones on her head. Please make it a grinning expression. A window in the background would be nice (a simple outline of light only would be fine).

Mini-Character
I would like the character in the reference image to be a two-headed mini character.
Please make the pose similar to the reference image.
The character should have a smiling expression with an open mouth.
It would be nice if the background is transparent.

That's all. I have always loved Mr. Niai's illustrations, so I am very happy to be able to work with him.
I would like to use your illustrations in my app IRIAM, as well as in my header and icons.

If your illustration does not meet our requirements, you can cancel your order.
Thank you very much for your consideration.
